workforce.error: The change could not be saved. Check the fields and try again.
workforce.readOnlyHint: You have read access, but lack the permission required to change this section.

skills.title: Skills catalogue
skills.hint: Skills are used by dispatch to require and match the right expertise. The key is stable and used in APIs and import files.
skills.empty: No skills have been registered yet.
skills.label: Name

staff.title: Employee skills, availability and absences
staff.hint: Select an employee to view and maintain skills, weekly availability and absences. Changes take effect in dispatch immediately.
staff.departmentFallback: Department: {department}. Availability and absences apply to this employee; the department is used when no per-person capacity is set.

userSkills.title: Skills
userSkills.hint: Tick the skills the employee holds. Level is optional (1–5), and the valid-until date is used when dispatch assesses the skill at the start of a work order.
userSkills.noSkills: Add skills to the catalogue above first.
userSkills.hidden: Employee skill details require the “manage employees” permission.

availability.title: Weekly availability
availability.hint: Times are local time in Oslo. Leave both fields empty for a day with no working hours. Windows on the same day cannot overlap, but they may touch.

absences.title: Absences
absences.hint: Absences block assignment during the period. Exactly the same start and end is rejected as a duplicate; partial overlap is allowed.

capacity.title: Capacity plans
capacity.hint: Set available minutes per department or per technician. 0 means a deliberately closed day. A technician row overrides the department row for the same day.
capacity.fallbackHint: Without an explicit row, the capacity view uses the department row, then opening hours. Technicians without their own row follow the department default.
capacity.empty: No explicit capacity plans in the period.

skills.title: Skill requirements
skills.hint: Select the skills the work order requires. Also tick “Required” for skills that must be valid for assignment; unticked requirements are desirable and only affect ranking.
skills.empty: No skills are registered. Add them under Settings → Workforce & skills.
skills.invalidMandatory: A skill cannot be required without being selected.
